A slight dip in oil prices and some calm in bond markets seem to be enough to inject a little bit of optimism. If that lasts is of course a whole different story.

Brent crude is still above $108 after all, tensions in the Middle East show no signs of abating, and then of course there's the looming Federal Reserve interest rate decision and press conference  - and itlooks like there could be quite some fallout from that as we head into the second half of the week.
Back in Europe, official data showed that British inflation accelerated to a five-month high of 3.1% in August from 2.9% in July  - just beforeThursday's Bank of England interest rate decision.
